variables.name: EGATE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the administrator sign-in; use a long unique value.

variables.name: EGATE_RESEND_API_KEY
variables.description: Resend API key used to send email.

variables.name: EGATE_DB
variables.description: SQLite database path. Keep the Uppr database at ./data/main.sqlite.

variables.name: EGATE_HOST
variables.description: Network interface to listen on. Use 0.0.0.0 in Uppr.

variables.name: EGATE_PORT
variables.description: HTTP listen port; keep 8119 in Uppr to match Docker EXPOSE.

variables.name: EGATE_LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Failed administrator logins allowed per IP in a rolling 24 hour window.
